verify:
import hashlib, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile
R = pathlib.Path(next(p for p in sys.path if (pathlib.Path(p) / 'include/kv/block_manager.h').is_file()))
C = pathlib.Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / 'paged-kv-eval-cache'
C.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def _obj(n):
    s = R / 'src' / (n + '.cpp')
    o = C / (n + '_' + hashlib.sha256(s.read_bytes()).hexdigest()[:16] + '.o')
    if not o.is_file():
        subprocess.run(['g++', '-std=c++17', '-O0', '-I', str(R / 'include'), '-c', str(s), '-o', str(o)], check=True)
    return str(o)
O = [_obj('block_manager'), _obj('kv_cache')]
def _run(code, extra=()):
    k = hashlib.sha256(code.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
    s = C / ('p_' + k + '.cpp'); b = C / ('p_' + k)
    if not b.is_file():
        s.write_text(code, encoding='utf-8')
        cmd = ['g++', '-std=c++17', '-O0', '-I', str(R / 'include'), str(s)] + ([str(x) for x in extra] or O) + ['-o', str(b)]
        subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
    return subprocess.run([str(b)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()

import re
def _suite(name):
    src = R / 'tests' / (name + '.cpp')
    k = 'suite_' + name
    b = C / k
    if not b.is_file():
        subprocess.run(['g++', '-std=c++17', '-O0', '-I', str(R / 'include'), str(src)] + O + ['-o', str(b)], check=True)
    return subprocess.run([str(b)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
a = re.search(r'ALL PASS \((\d+) checks\)', _suite('test_kv_cache')).group(1)
b = re.search(r'ALL PASS \((\d+) checks\)', _suite('test_prefix_cache')).group(1)
result = a + " " + b
